title: Gila e Lugge Ɓunndu
intro: Jahgol ruuhu suka fuɗɗorii ko e yi’annde doole ɓalli kammu ina cujjana e teddungal. Nguurndam oo neɗɗo ina maantini e janfa ɓurka luggiɗde e ɓeen ɓurɓe ɓadaade, rewi heen ko duuɓi maccungaagu e kasoo tooñannge. Kono e nder gooŋɗinal ngal aldaa e paltoor, ngalɗoo limngal ummiima e ɓuuɓri ɓurndi lesɗude, wonti gooto e yimɓe ɓurɓe doole e nder laamu mawngu. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade sifaa oo maccuɗo Alla teskinɗo?
clues: Mi hollitaama njiimaandi koode sappo e goo, naange e lewru ina cujjana yeeso am
Ko miin woni ɓiɗɗo jibinannde am giɗaaɗo no feewi, ko ɗum jibini kaaɗdi hakkunde banndiraaɓe am
Banndiraaɓe am nanngi mi, ɓoorni mi comci am, mberli mi e nder ɓuuɓri luggiɗndi, niɓɓiɗndi
Mi yeeyetee ko e marsandiis e nder luumo, mi nawaa mi woɗɗi leydi am
Debbo baawɗo etinooma bonnude teddungal am, mi werlaa e kasoo sabu mi jaɓaani yahrude yeeso makko
Mi barkitinaama e dokkal firo koyɗol, mi ummiima e kasoo yejjitaaɗo, mi wonti mawɗo jaagorɗe leydi Misira

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Werlo e nder ɓunndu luggiɗndu e banndiraaɓe mum
Haɓde e jaambaaro mawɗo e nder ladde hare
trial.answer: Werlo e nder ɓunndu luggiɗndu e banndiraaɓe mum

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Rose to mawɗo jaagorɗe leydi Ejipt e hawrude e ɓesngu giɗaaɗo
Mahi laana mawka, noddi yimɓe e iimanaagal
Ardiima leñol fof e maccungaagu to leydi Misira
Hokkaama laamu e njiimaandi dow ko yiyaaka
Hokkaama muñal rewrude e rafi bonɗo, selli
outcome.answer: Rose to mawɗo jaagorɗe leydi Ejipt e hawrude e ɓesngu giɗaaɗo

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ
verse: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic." (40:34)
